security_questions: What is the patient's date of birth?
Can you confirm the employer name?
authentication.notes: Manulife often requires group number upfront. Make sure to have it ready.

steps.expected_prompt: Welcome to Manulife. For English, press 1. French, press 2.
For dental providers, press 1. For members, press 2.
Please enter the group number followed by the pound sign.
steps.notes: Group number is often 6-8 digits. Different from member ID

steps.expected_prompt: For claim status, press 1. For eligibility, press 2. For all other inquiries, press 3.
Please hold for the next available representative.

common_denial_reasons.resolution: Check annual or lifetime maximums. Patient pays overage
Verify service is on plan schedule. Some plans exclude specific procedures
Common for cleanings (2/year), X-rays (1/year), fluoride. Check plan frequency schedule
Submit X-rays, narratives, or perio charts via fax or portal
Verify claim wasn't already paid. Check payment history
Verify employment dates and coverage effective date

key_phrases: I'm calling from [Practice Name] regarding a claim for [Patient Name]
Can you confirm the claim status?
What is the reason for the denial?
avoid_phrases: This is taking too long (Manulife processing is actually quite fast)
We sent this weeks ago (verify submission first)
escalation_triggers: Representative cannot locate claim with valid reference
Denial seems inconsistent with plan documents
Payment issued but never received (over 30 days)
ai_agent_guidance.representative_script_hints: Manulife reps are generally efficient and knowledgeable. They have good system access and can usually resolve issues on first call. If they can't find a claim, it likely wasn't received - prepare to resubmit.

metadata.notes: Manulife is one of the faster processors. They have a good provider portal that often has claim status before calling is necessary. Consider checking portal first. IVR is straightforward and reliable.
